spec.queryText:
SELECT
   (CAST(strftime('%s', I.end_time) AS INTEGER) / (60000/1000)) * (60000/1000) AS time
  ,SUM(WD.sum_duration_us) AS 'TestozzoSQLite'
FROM WorkloadDetails WD
    JOIN Intervals I ON WD.interval_id = I.interval_id
    JOIN Applications A ON A.application_id = WD.application_id
  WHERE A.application_name IN ("TESY_GEMO")
    AND time BETWEEN 1778140800 AND 1778162400
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY 1
spec.rawQueryText:

   (CAST(strftime('%s', I.end_time) AS INTEGER) / ($__interval_ms/1000)) * ($__interval_ms/1000) AS time
  ,SUM(WD.sum_duration_us) AS '${Baseline:text}'
FROM WorkloadDetails WD
    JOIN Intervals I ON WD.interval_id = I.interval_id
    JOIN Applications A ON A.application_id = WD.application_id
  WHERE A.application_name IN (${Application:doublequote})
    AND time BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY 1
